intro: The Cathedral is the spiritual and military heart of the Scarlet Monastery, housing the Crusade's inner sanctum. Once a serene hall of worship for Lordaeron's priesthood, it now serves as the command seat for High Inquisitor Whitemane and Scarlet Commander Mograine, guarded by the Crusade's most devoted zealots.

p: Once a peaceful center of enlightenment and prayer for the priesthood of Lordaeron, the Cathedral fell into madness in the wake of the Third War. Following the fall of the kingdom to the Scourge, surviving zealots transformed the complex into a fortress of unyielding hatred. Beyond the manicured cloister of the Chapel Gardens lies the grand Crusader's Chapel, where priests and warriors gather in devotion to their crusade. They view all outsiders—regardless of race or faction—as carriers of the undead plague who must be cleansed by blade and holy fire.
